title: Notification regarding Division bench of Hon'ble Chief Justice to be listed on 31st October, 2026 will be listed on 28/11/2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Bench matters scheduled to be listed on 31.10.2026 (Saturday) will be listed on 28.11.2026

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 30th October, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that on account of other official duties of Hon'ble The Chief Justice, the Division
Bench matters scheduled to be listed on 31.10.2026 (Saturday) will be listed on 28.11.2026
(Saturday) .
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
